## Personality

Tabitha Pratt is a stern-visaged, elderly unwed woman from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) who displays a severe yet kindly protective and good-natured demeanor. She holds little affection for felines and takes pride in her culinary skills, believing them to equal those of Miss Tolley.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P41](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0041), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P0](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P5](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0005)_

## History

Tabitha never married and was never courted or proposed to by any man, though she held no ill feelings toward men and would have gladly wed had the opportunity arisen. She stepped in to assist [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh by taking over the household chores so that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) could rest. Later, Tabitha arrived with news that her sister had broken her leg, which prompted [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) to temporarily move in with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh. After [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and Adrian declared their love for each other, Tabitha returned to the house bringing local gossip.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P2](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P11](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P24](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P19](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0019), +7 more_

## Quotes

> "Enjoy yourself and refrain from stressing over the kitchen supplies. The steering is in Tabitha’s hands. Owning a dog is pointless if you bark yourself. Each morning, I will bring breakfast up to your room."
>
> — Tabitha — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P3](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0003)

> "That he remains unmarried is truly strange, because a person of his sort could win anyone just by asking. Well, perhaps he resembles me and has hitherto failed to encounter his proper match."
>
> — Tabitha — [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN SAUL P8](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0008)

> "Should you be unable to, I shall refrain from attending, Mrs. Doctor, dear, despite Matilda’s leg. I refuse to cause you anxiety, and to have that sweet child disturbed as a result, for all the legs in existence."
>
> — Tabitha — [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P23](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0023)

> "It is my belief that some food and drink will be welcomed by us all. Instruct young Mrs. Doctor to be entirely free of concern—Tabitha is taking charge. Instruct her to occupy her thoughts solely with her infant."
>
> — Tabitha — [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010)

> "Never before have I beheld a newborn so pale—normally they are reddish or yellowish. Furthermore, its large eyes unclosed just like a baby several months along. That tiny, tiny creature! Oh, that tragic, youthful Mrs. Doctor!"
>
> — Tabitha — [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P20](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0020)
